notes: In 'in the midst of which I dwell' the of is given to the suffix as the construct's rectum (rule 19); the relative which is the written 'asher's. Marking the suffix unrepresented and giving of to tavekh was the competing reading.
In the first relative clause the bet is unrepresented because inhabit takes a bare object (rule 40), and the resumptive suffix is unrepresented beside the written relative (rule 22).
